# Flowseal tg-ws-proxy attribution

The isolated `telegram-transport` proof of concept reimplements the minimum
MTProto obfuscated-transport and Telegram WebSocket bridge behavior reviewed at
Flowseal/tg-ws-proxy commit
`21aaeb3aba97ad3b0ae39c6540a7b1afd12a3f7e`.

The upstream application, binaries, updater, Cloudflare fallback, mutable
domain list, user interface, tray lifecycle, and telemetry-like statistics are
not copied or packaged. The upstream MIT license is preserved in this
directory.
